supportingConnections.hypothesis: Stale statuses mislead prioritization; checking one suspected-done idea removes a false open item.
Several vague UI parents split the UI's value arbitrarily; one structural parent per area makes the flow readable.
Tools catch graph decay that manual organizing misses in a graph of hundreds of ideas written by several agents.
Thresholds checked against the live graph rather than samples keep hygiene reports actionable.
Intrinsic value on every idea drowns the few real sources of value; keeping it only on ends lets value flow from what actually matters.
